title: Fix duplicate expense vendor numbers during receipt submission
summary: Expense vendor number assignment now skips occupied numbers and surfaces numbering errors during receipt submission, preventing duplicate vendor key failures.
key_points: Matched and unmatched expense vendor creation both use the table's insert trigger for consistent numbering logic
Numbering follows the standard Vendor table pattern to skip already-occupied numbers
Number-series errors and warnings are no longer suppressed, surfacing actionable errors
Blank vendor keys from missing error handling are prevented
Four regression test scenarios validate the fix for normal and sequence series
quote: Prevent receipt submission from failing when the next expense vendor number already belongs to an existing record.
